# asym (Asymmetric.al)

> Open-source giving, donor portals, redacted missionary rosters, and office CRM on one shared record for missions organizations.

Built by Asymmetric.al, an independent, for-profit software company serving nonprofits, starting with missions organizations. Founded by Conrad O'Brien (who co-leads Global Fellowship) and Blake.

## Status
- Public codebase: https://github.com/Asymmetric-al/core (AGPL-3.0-only, 5,200+ commits on develop, 600+ repository-wide merged PRs since January 2026, verified November 2026).
- In public code: authenticated donor portal with individual receipts and settled-only annual statements (`apps/donor`, `packages/api/src/donor-portal`); assignment-scoped missionary supporter roster defaulting to `Anonymous partner` with `total_given` and `last_gift_amount` withheld (`apps/missionary`, `packages/api/src/missionary-portal`); Mission Control CRM, Payload Web Studio, and supported batch previews (`apps/admin`, `packages/api/src/admin/contribution-batches`).
- Partial: public worker directory and checkout recipient lookup in `apps/donor` still render `@asym/mock-data` sample profiles.
- In development (not open yet): hosted team subscription and onboarding (pricing unpublished), human-approved AI campaign/appeal drafting, and optional future managed donor care.
